_note: The one list of apps and the ways to get them. _build/hub.py builds /apps/ and /vi/apps/ from it, the short addresses (/get/, and /teacher/ etc. from "short") and a public copy at /apps/apps.json for AgentDeck and HQ. The latest .zip of each app ("zip" = its release tag prefix) is found in downloads/, filled by _build/downloads.py. Add an app or a channel here, then run python _build/hub.py (python _build/hub.py --check also asks every web app address whether it answers).
